title: NOVEL SYNTHESES OF PHENOSELENAZINEQUINONE INFRARED DYES
abstract: Abstract                New series of phenoselenazinequinone infrared dyes for optical recording medium have been synthesized by the ring-closure reaction between 2,3-dihalogenoquinones and zinc 2-aminobenzeneselenate. These dyes absorbed near infrared light at 700–830 nm.
